primitives.name: Numeric Token Sweep
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method: numeric-token sweep of each brief's Findings section against the source file text, with manual review of every miss.
primitives.assumptions: All numeric tokens in briefs must exactly match those in source files.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When token formatting differs (e.g., commas vs. periods), sweep fails.

layer2.mapping: Token sweep acts as a likelihood mapping from claim space to source space, enabling Bayesian verification.
layer2.telemetry: Hit rate and miss count per brief.

primitives.name: Verification Status Taxonomy
primitives.verbatim_quote: Status key (unified): VERIFIED = source re-opened, numbers/equations there as written.
primitives.assumptions: Each status reflects a distinct logical outcome of source validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Contradictions arise when source contradicts claim or itself.

layer2.mapping: Taxonomy defines a Boolean lattice over claim validity, enabling compositional reasoning.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency counts of each status across briefs.

primitives.name: Ledger Arithmetic Confidence
primitives.verbatim_quote: Standing caveat: arXiv-ledger claims are only as good as the ledger author's read; ledgers' own adversarial notes are quoted as first-class evidence.
primitives.assumptions: ArXiv-ledger integrity depends on authorial accuracy and adversarial scrutiny.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Confidence degrades when adversarial notes are present.

layer2.mapping: Ledger confidence maps to Bayesian prior adjustment based on adversarial note presence.
layer2.telemetry: Weighted average of confidence scores adjusted by adversarial note severity.
